title: This "Service" is a Ripoff and Customer Service is a Joke!
text:
I subscribed to Pusheen Box back in Summer of 2020 because I wanted something to cheer us up while we were all stuck in our homes and unable to go or do anything due to my husband's job. The first box (Summer), was fine, but it had some issues in shipping making its way to us. That's fine, most of the items in the box were cute and seemed to be mostly well made.

Both Fall and Winter boxes (2020) had shipping issues and it took over two weeks to get to us, despite being shipped FedEx. Items in the box were mixed; the clothing items were of quality, but almost everything else in the boxes outside of the figurines was dollar store or knock-off quality that you'd see for sale in a a dollar store or from a "third-party" vendor from China here on Amazon. Numerous people complained that their electronic lantern in the fall box was broken and didn't work... Pusheen Box did not offer refunds to anyone... and instead told them to go find EXTREMELY specific battery brands to use in the lantern (which didn't fix the problem). The Winter Box had dollar store salt and pepper shakers and "wine" glasses. The glasses I received were imperfect and had bubbles trapped in the glass. The decals were placed over glasses with nub defects (small bits of glass sticking out of an otherwise smooth surface). No refunds or replacements were offered to anyone with these issues or if they were, people never GOT the replacements they were promised.

Fast forward to Spring 2021. The box was charged to my account on March 17. The box's release was delayed with NO REASON given by the company.. so it didn't even "ship" until April 28th. I didn't get any tracking information until May 4th... and it's been stuck in limbo with no updates and several "delivery" dates that have been passed on.

Add to that that you can't get a hold of ANYONE at their customer support. You send an email into the void and you MIGHT get a response 5 days later that is cursory and mostly doesn't answer your complaints or questions. It's May 19th now... and I still have no Spring Box, STILL have not heard back from customer service despite THREE SEPARATE tickets being launched. I have only received ONE response about tracking not updating.. and that was on May 14th. NOTHING since then, my package is still lost... and you can't even call up FedEx to look into it because Culture Fly (the company that runs these boxes) has a "sticky" on all the boxes, stating that the receiver (me) has to contact them (the sender) to launch an investigation... but how am I supposed to that when you NEVER REPLY TO YOUR EMAILS?!?!

So subpar service, SLOW delivery times, lost packages and declining quality of items in just 9 months... I do NOT recommend anyone purchase a sub from this company. Do yourself a favor and look up other reviews about this company on other review aggregate sites. It's not pretty. I wish I had.
label: negative
